title: Underwater UFO cases back to the 1800s
summary: Kevin Knuth tells of Underwater UFO cases back to the 1800s, about 1800s-present at Oceans, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
he just released a book
about UFOs in the water,
underwater UFOs, and his cases go back to the
1800s.

plain: Kevin Knuth, a physicist and former NASA scientist, mentions a new book by Richard Dolan, a historian who writes about UFOs, about UFOs seen in and under the ocean. According to Knuth, Dolan's cases go back to the 1800s, which if true would mean such sightings in the water have been reported for well over a century.
